mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Mantra</titleLeft><mainText>Karma's next ability is empowered, giving it a bonus effect.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Karma empowers her next Ability used within 8 seconds.
  • {{Spell_KarmaQ_Name}}: Deals an additional @RQImpactDamage@ magic damage and leaves behind a circle of flame, Slowing enemies and dealing an additional @RQFieldDamage@ magic damage.
  • {{Spell_KarmaSpiritBind_Name}}: Karma will restore @RWHealAmount@ missing Health at the beginning and end of the tether, and Root for @RWBonusRoot@s longer.
  • {{Spell_KarmaSolKimShield_Name}}: Karma shields her target for @REBonusShield@ more Shield, and also shields allies near her target, granting them @REBonusShieldArea@ Shield and @REMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Gathering Fire</titleLeft><mainText>Reduces Mantra's cooldown by <scaleLevel>@f1@</scaleLevel> seconds each time Karma damages an enemy champion with one of her abilities (<scaleLevel>@f2@</scaleLevel> second reduction on basic attacks).</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Karma begins the game with a point in {{Spell_KarmaMantra_Name}}.

She reduces the Cooldown of {{Spell_KarmaMantra_Name}} by @SpellMantraRefund@ seconds when she damages a champion with an Ability.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Inspired</titleLeft><mainText>This unit has increased Move Speed. Vroom Vroom!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Spirit Link</titleLeft><mainText>This unit is linked to Karma and will be rooted if the link is not broken.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.
